summary.text: Virgil Thornton is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 86th District since January 14, 2026.
The district covers part of York County, part of the City of Hampton and the City of Poquoson.
The House profile lists Virgil Thornton as retired.

paragraphs.text: Virgil Thornton was born in Newport News, Virginia.
The profile lists the Newport News Apprentice School and the National Automotive Dealer Academy (NADA) under education.
Virgil Thornton serves on the Counties, Cities and Towns; Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources; and Courts of Justice committees.
